description: Amazon focuses heavily on Data Structures, Algorithms, and System Design for experienced roles, but places immense weight on their 16 Leadership Principles.

phases.name: Phase 1: DSA Core & LP Basics
phases.description: Master the core DSA topics and memorize the 16 Leadership Principles.

milestones.title: Trees & Graphs Mastery
milestones.description: Solve 20 medium/hard LeetCode questions focusing on BFS/DFS and Binary Trees.

milestones.title: Leadership Principles Story Matrix
milestones.description: Create a STAR-format story matrix for all 16 Leadership Principles.

phases.name: Phase 2: Object-Oriented Design (OOD)
phases.description: Amazon frequently asks OOD questions like 'Design a Parking Lot' or 'Design Amazon Locker'.

milestones.title: OOD Principles (SOLID)
milestones.description: Review SOLID principles and design patterns.

milestones.title: Mock OOD Interview
milestones.description: Do a mock interview designing a real-world entity.

description: Google interviews are notoriously difficult on the algorithms front. Expect Dynamic Programming, Graphs, and open-ended problem solving.

phases.name: Phase 1: Advanced Algorithms
phases.description: Focus intensely on hard algorithmic problems.

milestones.title: Graph Algorithms
milestones.description: Dijkstra's, Topological Sort, and Union Find.

phases.name: Phase 2: System Design & Culture
phases.description: System Design for L4+ and 'Googleyness' behavioral questions.

milestones.title: Distributed Systems
milestones.description: Study MapReduce, BigTable, and distributed consensus.

milestones.title: Googleyness Prep
milestones.description: Prepare scenarios where you handled ambiguity and showed leadership.

description: Microsoft interviews focus on strong coding fundamentals, debugging skills, system design, and cultural fit.

phases.name: Phase 1: Core Fundamentals
phases.description: Solidify string manipulation, arrays, and linked lists.

milestones.title: Strings & Arrays
milestones.description: Practice two-pointer and sliding window techniques.

phases.name: Phase 2: System Design & Behavioral
phases.description: Prepare for high-level system design and past experience deep-dives.

milestones.title: System Design Prep
milestones.description: Study load balancing, caching, and database scaling.

milestones.title: Experience Deep-Dive
milestones.description: Prepare to discuss your past projects in detail.
